device.name: Hanmatek HM bench supply (labmastro Modbus RTU)

facts.text: HanmatekHmInstrument opens the port in Modbus RTU mode with slave address 1 by default, at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit and a 1 s timeout.
get_voltage reads holding register 0x0010 with two decimals (function code 3); get_current reads 0x0011 with three decimals and divides that result by 1000 again before returning it.
set_voltage writes int(voltage * 100) to register 0x0030 and set_current writes int(current * 1000) to 0x0031, both with function code 6.
set_over_voltage_protection writes int(volts * 100) to 0x0020 and set_over_current_protection writes int(amps * 1000) to 0x0021 with function code 6.
power_on and power_off write 1 and 0 to register 0x0001 and then return get_power_status, which reads 0x0001 and reports False only for 0.
get_power combines registers 0x0012 and 0x0013 as (high_power < 16) + low_power, a comparison rather than a shift.
set_over_power_protection splits int(watts * 1000) into a high word for 0x0022 and a low word for 0x0023 and writes them with two separate function code 6 requests.
